answer: Bindings are kept in ocean, verified in zenith, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the nectar check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. That is 1859 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
